subject: Insurance
title: Workers' Compensation Origins
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Workers' Compensation Origins.

hook.text: In 1884, Germany passed the first workers' compensation law.

buildup.text: Before this, injured workers had to prove their employer was negligent in court.

discovery.text: Bismarck's system was a deal: workers gave up the right to sue, and employers guaranteed compensation for all injuries.

twist.text: Bismarck wasn't motivated by compassion. He wanted to prevent socialist revolution by making workers loyal to the state.

climax.text: Workers' comp spread worldwide. The model of trading lawsuit rights for guaranteed benefits reshaped labor forever.

punchline.text: No lawsuit needed. Bismarck traded courts for guaranteed worker pay.

quiz.question: Why did Bismarck create workers' compensation?
options: To prevent socialist revolution by securing worker loyalty
